#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077

# R8 legacy Flat Root Candidate preparation only.
# This operator never publishes, switches CURRENT, changes Nginx/systemd, or touches DB.
SOURCE_SHA=0f4009c9f8c253f42e60394841795522bbaaa24d
SOURCE_TREE_SHA=11a50aa52fdc388de5e776e4bc1fea477ca40fb9
SOURCE_BUNDLE_SHA256=69375f6f93548d647e3c2d4f820acac7e17145cc02c334436b3d45dc1efb4e88
TOOLING_SHA=03f99c207627cf49e992b1481020ed256f237ab6
TOOLING_TREE_SHA=7becfdbd12fece2adb66b51b346918315fca4a64
TOOLING_BUNDLE_SHA256=e4b7ab3af6b23d1f89d9a4fb65a2714951da859c220d9cdf1ef10538bc3aaa18
RUNTIME_SHA256=f77f6440a6a95793fa28f2b51100227422ec978ba3234924ad90b6c25d0d71aa
BASELINE_SHA='e9fcc837a1ac9847f3966fc8ddb2aed92ca473fc'
BASELINE_ATTEMPT_ID='r8-legacy-baseline-e9fcc837-20260916T014723Z-3473778'
CANDIDATE_PARENT='/home/zcyu/coverage_candidate'
PYTHON_BIN="${FOS_R8_PYTHON:-python3}"

if [ "$#" -gt 1 ]; then echo 'usage: bash $0 [--self-test]' >&2; exit 2; fi
ACTION=build
if [ "${1:-}" = '--self-test' ]; then ACTION=self-test; fi
if [ "${1:-}" != '' ] && [ "${1:-}" != '--self-test' ]; then
  echo 'unknown argument; only --self-test is supported' >&2
  exit 2
fi

for REQUIRED in sha256sum awk base64 git; do
  command -v "$REQUIRED" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "$REQUIRED is required" >&2; exit 1; }
done
command -v "$PYTHON_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Python executable is unavailable: $PYTHON_BIN" >&2; exit 1; }
OPERATOR_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$0" | awk '{print $1}')
case "$OPERATOR_SHA256" in [0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]*) ;; *) echo 'operator SHA256 unavailable' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac

extract_payload() {
  local NAME="$1" TARGET="$2" EXPECTED="$3" BEGIN="$4" END="$5"
  if [ -e "$TARGET" ] || [ -L "$TARGET" ]; then
    echo "$NAME destination already exists: $TARGET" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  local TEMP="${TARGET}.tmp.$$"
  awk -v begin="$BEGIN" -v end="$END" '$0 == begin {inside=1; next} $0 == end {inside=0; exit} inside {print}' "$0" | base64 -d > "$TEMP"
  if [ ! -f "$TEMP" ] || [ -L "$TEMP" ]; then
    echo "$NAME extraction failed" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  local OBSERVED
  OBSERVED=$(sha256sum "$TEMP" | awk '{print $1}')
  if [ "$OBSERVED" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
    echo "$NAME SHA256 mismatch" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  mv "$TEMP" "$TARGET"
}

if [ "$ACTION" = self-test ]; then
  SELF_TEST_ROOT=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fos-r8-flat-self-test.XXXXXX")
  trap 'rm -rf -- "$SELF_TEST_ROOT"' EXIT
  mkdir -p "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/input"
  extract_payload source-bundle "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/input/source.bundle" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE_SHA256" __R8_SOURCE_BUNDLE_BEGIN__ __R8_SOURCE_BUNDLE_END__
  extract_payload tooling-bundle "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/input/tooling.bundle" "$TOOLING_BUNDLE_SHA256" __R8_TOOLING_BUNDLE_BEGIN__ __R8_TOOLING_BUNDLE_END__
  extract_payload runtime "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/runtime.py" "$RUNTIME_SHA256" __R8_RUNTIME_BEGIN__ __R8_RUNTIME_END__
  "$PYTHON_BIN" "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/runtime.py" --mode self-test \
    --source-bundle "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/input/source.bundle" \
    --tooling-bundle "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/input/tooling.bundle" \
    --source-root "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/source" \
    --tooling-root "$SELF_TEST_ROOT/tooling" \
    --source-bundle-sha256 "$SOURCE_BUNDLE_SHA256" \
    --tooling-bundle-sha256 "$TOOLING_BUNDLE_SHA256"
  echo "OPERATOR_SHA256=$OPERATOR_SHA256"
  echo 'PRODUCTION_MUTATION=NONE'
  exit 0
fi

HOSTNAME_SHORT=$(hostname -s)
if [ "$HOSTNAME_SHORT" != 'vfoswind' ]; then echo "operator must run on hostname=vfoswind (observed $HOSTNAME_SHORT)" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ -L "$CANDIDATE_PARENT" ]; then echo 'candidate parent may not be a symlink' >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ ! -d "$CANDIDATE_PARENT" ]; then mkdir -p "$CANDIDATE_PARENT"; fi
ATTEMPT_TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
SESSION_ID="r8-flat-candidate-0f4009c9-$ATTEMPT_TIMESTAMP-$$"
STATE_ROOT="$CANDIDATE_PARENT/r8-production-candidate-0f4009c9-$ATTEMPT_TIMESTAMP-$$"
if [ -e "$STATE_ROOT" ] || [ -L "$STATE_ROOT" ]; then echo 'candidate state collision; refusing to continue' >&2; exit 1; fi
mkdir "$STATE_ROOT"
mkdir -p "$STATE_ROOT/input"
extract_payload source-bundle "$STATE_ROOT/input/source.bundle" "$SOURCE_BUNDLE_SHA256" __R8_SOURCE_BUNDLE_BEGIN__ __R8_SOURCE_BUNDLE_END__
extract_payload tooling-bundle "$STATE_ROOT/input/tooling.bundle" "$TOOLING_BUNDLE_SHA256" __R8_TOOLING_BUNDLE_BEGIN__ __R8_TOOLING_BUNDLE_END__
extract_payload runtime "$STATE_ROOT/runtime.py" "$RUNTIME_SHA256" __R8_RUNTIME_BEGIN__ __R8_RUNTIME_END__
"$PYTHON_BIN" "$STATE_ROOT/runtime.py" --mode build \
  --source-bundle "$STATE_ROOT/input/source.bundle" \
  --tooling-bundle "$STATE_ROOT/input/tooling.bundle" \
  --source-root "$STATE_ROOT/source" \
  --tooling-root "$STATE_ROOT/tooling" \
  --source-bundle-sha256 "$SOURCE_BUNDLE_SHA256" \
  --tooling-bundle-sha256 "$TOOLING_BUNDLE_SHA256" \
  --state-root "$STATE_ROOT" \
  --session-id "$SESSION_ID" \
  --operator-sha256 "$OPERATOR_SHA256"

exit 0
